title: Measure results CSV export and duplicate-ballot logging
context: Repo: ourtown-civic, a FastAPI app where verified residents cast anonymous ballots on local measures. Anonymity is a core promise: ballots are stored without user ids and a resident's choice must never be linkable to their identity anywhere outside the tally. Admin-only routes use Depends(require_role("admin")). Application logs ship to a third-party log host readable by the whole support team.
artifact:
PR #231: Results CSV export for closed measures + better duplicate-ballot diagnostics

Clerks have asked for a downloadable tally once a measure closes so they can attach it to the council packet.
Adds GET /measures/{id}/results.csv for admins, returning one row per choice with counts.
Also adds a log line when a duplicate ballot is rejected, since support keeps getting "it says I already voted" tickets and we have no way to see what happened.

+@router.get("/measures/{measure_id}/results.csv")
+async def export_results(
+    measure_id: int,
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    measure = db.get(Measure, measure_id)
+    if measure is None:
+        raise HTTPException(404)
+    counts = dict(
+        db.query(Ballot.choice, func.count(Ballot.id))
+        .filter(Ballot.measure_id == measure_id)
+        .group_by(Ballot.choice)
+        .all()
+    )
+    buf = io.StringIO()
+    writer = csv.writer(buf)
+    writer.writerow(["measure", "choice", "votes"])
+    for choice in Choice:
+        writer.writerow([measure.slug, choice.value, counts.get(choice, 0)])
+    buf.seek(0)
+    return StreamingResponse(
+        buf,
+        media_type="text/csv",
+        headers={
+            "Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="{measure.slug}-results.csv"'
+        },
+    )

defects.description: The duplicate-ballot log line records the voter's email together with the ballot choice, linking identity to voting preference in logs shipped to a third party, breaking the anonymity guarantee.

Description says the export is admin-only and for closed measures, but the new route has no require_role (unlike close_measure in the same file) and no is_open check, so anyone can pull live tallies of an open measure mid-vote.

decoys: CSV output cannot carry formula/CSV injection from voters: rows are built from the Choice enum values and integer counts via csv.writer, not free text.
